purpose: Derived orchestration metadata over the locked sales/conversation state; does not replace authoritative existing state and does not duplicate raw PII.

existing_state_bindings.awaited_resolution_rule: Use sales_state.conversion.awaiting_field first, then sales_state.journey.awaiting_entity, matching locked WU-104 behavior.

active_objective_intent.description: Current semantic business objective after precedence rules.

student_context_epoch.description: Opaque counter incremented on a confirmed child/student context boundary; not an identity or PII value.

suspended_objective_intent.description: Prior objective suspended by support/policy/handoff interruption. It must not auto-resume without a new customer signal.

action_state.description: ACTION_SUCCESS may only be set from an authoritative downstream tool/gateway success signal.

known_field_names.description: Optional privacy-safe names of known fields only; no raw values in WU-106 telemetry/evidence.

context_scopes.student_switch_rule: On a clear child/student switch, increment student_context_epoch and invalidate incompatible student-scoped assumptions. Parent-shared fields may carry only when safe and already validated.

transition_rules.when: clear current semantic intent differs from active objective and no stronger locked override applies
transition_rules.then: set active_objective_intent to current intent; preserve only compatible trusted context

transition_rules.when: explicit correction targets a known field
transition_rules.then: replace only the corrected field in authoritative existing state; preserve compatible fields; do not re-ask the corrected field

transition_rules.when: message binds deterministically to the locked WU-104 awaited field/entity
transition_rules.then: preserve active objective and mark awaited binding; do not reinterpret as unrelated new action

transition_rules.when: clear second child/student context is introduced
transition_rules.then: increment student_context_epoch; clear incompatible student-scoped assumptions; preserve safe parent-shared context only

transition_rules.when: support, complaint, or explicit human handoff override applies
transition_rules.then: move active objective to suspended_objective_intent when useful; make override the active objective; stop sales progression

transition_rules.when: general policy question interrupts an active sales journey
transition_rules.then: answer policy as current objective without mutating pending business action; keep prior objective suspended; do not auto-resume

transition_rules.when: customer explicitly returns to a suspended prior objective
transition_rules.then: restore that objective only if still compatible with current trusted state and no safety override applies

transition_rules.when: customer changes response language but business intent is semantically continuous
transition_rules.then: change current_language only; preserve semantic trusted context and objective

transition_rules.when: availability or schedule preference is supplied without authoritative live result
transition_rules.then: action_state must remain PREFERENCE_COLLECTED or LIVE_CHECK_REQUIRED; never ACTION_SUCCESS

transition_rules.when: booking, registration, refund, or handoff execution is requested
transition_rules.then: action_state may become ACTION_PENDING only after the existing deterministic action gateway accepts the request; ACTION_SUCCESS requires authoritative tool success
